mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.certification_id, q.question_text, q.choice1, q.choice2, q.choice3, q.choice4, q.answer_no, q.explanation, COALESCE(s.weight, 1) AS weight FROM certification_question q LEFT JOIN member_question_stat s ON s.question_id = q.id AND s.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE q.certification_id = #{certificationId} AND q.deleted = 0
SELECT id, certification_id, question_text, choice1, choice2, choice3, choice4, answer_no, explanation, created_at FROM certification_question WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM certification_question WHERE certification_id = #{certificationId} AND deleted = 0
